title: Pokemon TCG Charcadet 026/182 Paradox Rift Cosmos Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Charcadet Cosmos Holo 026/182 Paradox Rift card is a Fire-type Pokémon card from the Pokémon TCG game. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2023, this English-language card features the character Charcadet in its Basic stage. With a Holo finish and belonging to the Common rarity, this card is part of the Paradox Rift set and is made of standard-sized card stock. The card is not autographed and does not have a vintage feel, making it suitable for players aged 6 and above.
